steps.name: create-branch
steps.description: Create task/t0102_seedscale_n4_gen20 worktree and plan step list (all 8 optional steps included per experiment-run + answer-question + data-analysis task type union).

steps.name: check-deps
steps.description: Verify all 9 dependency tasks (t0024, t0080, t0083, t0090, t0091, t0092, t0093, t0099, t0101) are completed and their assets are reusable.

steps.name: init-folders
steps.description: Create mandatory task folder structure including assets/predictions and assets/answer subdirs for the 2 predictions + 1 answer asset.

steps.name: research-papers
steps.description: Re-read Poleg-Polsky 2026 Methods on seeds/generations balance; document PP-2026 numbers and the t0091/t0099 lineage findings in research/research_papers.md.

steps.name: research-internet
steps.description: Search for recent (2025-2026) literature on NSGA-II hyperparameter scheduling and noise replicate ablation in evolutionary multi-objective optimisation of neuron models.

steps.name: research-code
steps.description: Audit t0099 run_loop.py, t0080 constants.py, t0086 clustering, t0093 morphology generator; document import-shadow strategy for N_SEEDS override.

steps.name: planning
steps.description: Produce plan/plan.md with cost breakdown, machine spec, REQ-1..REQ-N requirement list, and adaptive HV-plateau stop criterion.

steps.name: setup-machines
steps.description: Provision one Vast.ai EPYC 7B13 64-core Norway instance matching t0099's spec ($0.24/hr target); SCP code; verify smoke gate.

steps.name: implementation
steps.description: Run NSGA-II twice (seed=44, seed=55) at pop=96, gens=20, N_SEEDS=4 on the 68-d substrate; pull predictions back; build 2 predictions assets.

steps.name: teardown
steps.description: Destroy Vast.ai instance after both seeds complete; record final cost in costs.json and remote_machines_used.json; run verify_machines_destroyed.

steps.name: creative-thinking
steps.description: Out-of-the-box analysis: per-seed warm-start vs random; whether N_SEEDS=4 underestimates DSI variance for high-Pareto cells.

steps.name: results
steps.description: Write results_summary.md, results_detailed.md, metrics.json, costs.json; embed plots (HV curves, anchor distribution, DSI vs PD scatter) in results/images/.

steps.name: compare-literature
steps.description: Compare DSI/PD scatter at N_SEEDS=4 vs Poleg-Polsky 2026 N=1 and our N_SEEDS=20 baseline; quantify variance gap.

steps.name: suggestions
steps.description: Generate follow-up suggestions; check for duplicates against t0099's S-0099-* and t0101's S-0101-* backlog.

steps.name: reporting
steps.description: Run all verificators, capture session transcripts, set task.json status=completed and end_time, prepare for PR.
